## Activity

The completed captures provide the activity base for the image-quality and grading results described below.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 1 was assessed as ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 2.0 per cent. The result indicates that the available images were generally suitable for review, with only a small proportion unable to support grading. The ungradable image has been included in the reported activity and quality figures.

## Grading

A total of 5 results were graded as referable. The median grading wait was 0 days, indicating that the midpoint result was processed without a recorded delay. Overall, the reporting period shows completed activity, a low ungradable rate, and timely grading performance for River Outreach during July 2026.
